Indian student found dead in London amid family's concerns over loan and education

Srinath Reddy, a 25-year-old Indian student from Telangana, was found dead in his room in London on June 23. The incident has raised questions about the circumstances surrounding his death, particularly given that he had taken a loan to pursue his master's degree abroad.
